issues: The play-cost reduction uses dynamic amount {"op":"banishedCount"}, but this dynamic amount is not in the ability reference. It should encode "This costs X less to play. X equals the number of cards in your banished zone" with a supported dynamic banished-zone count amount; implement a new DamageAmount such as banishedCount for this.

The fanfare's second step is incorrect: the source says "Banish a card from your hand," not discard a card. It should be encoded as a hand-to-banish effect after drawing. Since the ability reference has no implemented operation for banishing a chosen card from hand, implement a new effect such as banishFromHand(count/filter) and use that here instead of {"op":"discard","count":1}.

The additional cost "banish a card from your EX area" is encoded as part of the spell effect instead of as an additional play cost; it should be represented as a required cast cost before resolution. Since the ability reference has no spell additional-cost wrapper, implement support for spell play costs/additional costs and move the EX-area banish there.

The banishFromExArea step is incomplete because it omits the required filter field in the implemented shape. It should specify a valid filter or, if any EX-area card may be banished, support an any-card EX-area selector in the engine.

The EX-area cost reduction is missing the condition "If there is a Gilnelise, Omen of Craving on your field". Add a named-follower-on-field condition along with the existing in-EX-area condition so the reduction applies only while this card is in your EX area and Gilnelise, Omen of Craving is on your field.

The second part of On Evolve is encoded incorrectly as tutorFromHand. The source says the opponent reveals their hand, you select a card in it, and that opponent discards that selected card. It should be encoded as a targeted opponent-hand discard effect after revealing hand information.

The engine lacks an implemented operation for "opponent reveals hand; choose a card from it; opponent discards that card." Implement a new effect such as opponentRevealHandSelectDiscard (or equivalent reveal-opponent-hand plus targeted-discard-from-opponent-hand sequence) and use it after dealing 2 damage to your leader.
